[{"Name":"Sreejith A S","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjXh3v9SdsFqk1iYSbo5ZtKaFap0ilgXFmdPiI_O9sZa2OKA8uMQ=s120-c-rp-mo-br100","Rating":1,"Description":"Absolutely Disappointed – Please Avoid This Property at All Costs
I had one of the worst experiences staying at this Zolo property recently, and I feel it's important to share this to prevent others from falling into the same trap.
1. Pathetic Room Quality: The rooms are in extremely poor condition — unhygienic, poorly maintained, and nothing close to what you’d expect for the price you're paying.
2. Completely Misleading Photos: The pictures shared by the Zolo executive during the booking process were completely misleading. What I was shown versus what I actually got were two entirely different properties. This is nothing short of a scam.
3. Overpriced and Unjustified Rent: The monthly rent is absurdly high considering the substandard quality of rooms and facilities. It simply doesn't add up.
4. Hidden Charges Galore: At the time of booking, no one tells you about the long list of hidden charges you’ll face while vacating. These include check-out fees, early exit fees, and other surprise deductions that are never communicated in advance.
5. Unreasonable Vacating Rules: The exit process is deliberately made difficult, with too many conditions, unnecessary rules, and financial penalties. The policies are customer-unfriendly and designed to trap you.
6. Unjustified Electricity Bills: We received an excessive electricity bill for just a single day in a two-sharing room — without using any heavy appliances. There’s absolutely no transparency in how they calculate usage.
7. Awful Customer Support: The customer service is shockingly bad. Every time you raise a concern, they have a ready-made excuse. No accountability, no resolution — just endless justification.
This review is purely based on my personal experience. I'm not sure how the other positive reviews were formed, but my stay was far from satisfactory — and I wouldn't recommend this to anyone without a detailed personal visit and full understanding of their hidden policies.
Do NOT trust what Zolo executives tell you. Always visit the property in person before making any commitments. 𝗣𝗴 𝗰𝗮𝗿𝗲𝘁𝗮𝗸𝗲𝗿 : He is kind, polite and helpful. In fact, all the people working in this pg are good. In some reviews, you may see, people reviewing them as bad... Well, if you argue with someone, no one will stay quiet. He was quick in refunding the deposit as well.
